title: Owner voice test
intro: A short owner-only call. The server checks current free-credit evidence and provider settings before it creates a call. Your browser will ask for microphone access first.
starting: Checking microphone, provider settings and call binding…
connected: Call connected. Speak to the receptionist, then end the call.
ended: Call ended. Refresh records to see the verified transcript and outcome.
permission: Microphone permission or a secure browser connection is required. No call was created if permission failed.
joinError: The call could not be joined. Check its recorded state before trying again with the same operation.
unavailable: Voice tests are disabled until the server release checks pass.
ownerOnly: Only the signed-in owner can run voice tests.
statusUnavailable: Call recovery status is unavailable. Starting another call is blocked until it can be checked.
manualRecovery: The provider may have created this call. Check the provider dashboard and reconcile this exact operation before another call.
reconciling: Checking the existing call. No new call is being created.
reconciled: The provider confirmed this call has ended. Its call slot is released.
resumeExisting: An existing call is bound. Resume that same operation; another call is blocked.
availability: Provider execution is disabled by configuration.

failures.external_execution_disabled: This provider action is disabled in this release.
failures.native_free_entitlement_unverified: The current free-credit and billing check is unavailable or expired. No call was created.
failures.native_profile_drift: The provider configuration changed. Review it before a call.
failures.native_call_capacity_reached: Another call may still be active. Check its state first.
failures.native_operation_requires_reconciliation: The earlier creation outcome is uncertain. Reconcile it before another attempt.
failures.native_create_unverified: The provider creation outcome is uncertain. Do not start a new operation.
failures.native_reconciliation_unverified: The provider has not confirmed that this exact call ended. Its slot stays reserved; check again later.
failures.native_operation_not_found: This operation is unavailable to the current owner. Refresh your session and records.
failures.native_owner_required: Only the signed-in owner can start a voice call.
failures.csrf_required: Your session needs refreshing before starting a call.
failures.authorization_required: Sign in again before starting a call.
